import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, RandomizedSearchCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.stats import uniform, randint

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Define consistent label mapping that matches submission columns order (EAP, HPL, MWS)
author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}

# Split training data into train/validation (stratified) - genuine hold-out
X_train_text, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train["text"],
    train["author_code"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train["author_code"],
)

# Define parameter distributions for RandomizedSearchCV
param_dist_word = {
    "max_features": randint(5000, 20000),
    "ngram_range": [(1, 1), (1, 2), (2, 2)],
    "stop_words": ["english", None],
    "lowercase": [True],
}

param_dist_char = {
    "analyzer": ["char"],
    "ngram_range": [(2, 2), (3, 3), (3, 4)],
    "max_features": randint(10000, 30000),
    "lowercase": [True],
}

param_nb = {
    "alpha": uniform(0.01, 1.0),
}


# Create vectorizers with distributions
def fit_vectorizer(texts, params):
    vec = TfidfVectorizer(**params)
    return vec.fit_transform(texts)


# Fit word vectorizer on training text only
X_train_word = fit_vectorizer(X_train_text, param_dist_word.copy())
X_val_word = fit_vectorizer(X_val_text, param_dist_word.copy())
X_test_word = fit_vectorizer(test["text"], param_dist_word.copy())

# Fit char vectorizer on training text only
X_train_char = fit_vectorizer(X_train_text, param_dist_char.copy())
X_val_char = fit_vectorizer(X_val_text, param_dist_char.copy())
X_test_char = fit_vectorizer(test["text"], param_dist_char.copy())

# Concatenate features
X_train_combined = np.hstack([X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray()])
X_val_combined = np.hstack([X_val_word.toarray(), X_val_char.toarray()])
X_test_combined = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray()])

# Train classifier
clf = MultinomialNB()

# Evaluate initial model for baseline
clf.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)
y_val_pred = clf.predict_proba(X_val_combined)
y_val_pred = np.clip(y_val_pred, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
baseline_score = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Baseline score: {baseline_score:.6f}")

# Now do hyperparameter optimization
random_search = RandomizedSearchCV(
    MultinomialNB(),
    [{"alpha": param_dist_nb}],
    n_iter=20,
    cv=None,  # No CV, will do external validation
    scoring="neg_log_loss",
    refit=True,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
)

# Since sklearn doesn't support passing custom transforms easily with RandomizedSearchCV,
# we'll manually evaluate different configurations
best_alpha = 0.1
best_score = baseline_score
final_clf = None

# Search different alpha values combined with our fixed good TF-IDF setup
for alpha in [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 5.0]:
    clf_temp = MultinomialNB(alpha=alpha)
    clf_temp.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)
    y_val_pred = clf_temp.predict_proba(X_val_combined)
    y_val_pred = np.clip(y_val_pred, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    score = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred)
    print(f"Alpha {alpha}: {score:.6f}")
    if score < best_score:
        best_score = score
        best_alpha = alpha
        final_clf = clf_temp

# Retrain with best alpha on full training data (not including original val set)
# We need to exclude val from training for this step

    train[train["author"].isin(X_val_text.index & train.index)].index
)

print(f"\nBest alpha found: {best_alpha}")
print(f"Best validation score: {best_score:.6f}")

# Make predictions on test set
y_test_pred = clf_final.predict_proba(X_test_combined)

# Create submission
